turns.text: That is our firewood pile. I cover it with a tarp every night, but it sits right against the wall.
The brush is what I cut last weekend. I have not hauled it away yet, it is still green.
This fence is old cedar. It was here when we bought the place.

findings.instruction: A nighttime tarp is not enough, so move the pile more than 30 feet from the house or cover it fully with sheet metal.
findings.reason: The first frame shows the uncovered wood pile stacked against the house wall, and you said it sits right against the wall.

findings.instruction: Even though the old cedar came with the place, swap the 5 feet near the house for metal or brick that will not burn.
findings.reason: The third frame shows the old cedar fence meeting the house wall.

findings.instruction: Haul the cut brush you left last weekend to yard waste pickup, even while green, to clear within 30 feet.
findings.reason: The second frame shows the cut brush piled on the ground by the house, and you said you have not hauled it away yet.
